newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco to clean up electoral lists.
newsitem.headline: Morocco to clean up electoral lists.

text.p: Morocco said on Thursday it was reviewing electoral lists to eliminate irregularities and had already spotted more than 400,000 people registered twice.
Interior Minister Driss Basri told a news conference that a commission representing all the political parties would monitor the lists and return them to local communities in case of discrepancies.
The commission started work on December 1 and had already spotted more than 400,000 people registered twice on the lists, he said. The revision would end on March 31.
"We will register everybody but will eliminate those who are not entitled to figure on the lists," Basri said.
Morocco is expecting fresh elections after more than 10 million electors voted on September 13 to approve King Hassan's proposal to split the parliament into two chambers.
The lower house will be elected directly and the upper house indirectly.
